free_tier.stated: No free tier stated; GPU instances are billed per hour in yuan from an Alipay-funded balance, with a new-user price on the first instance. Prices are shown only in the console: no H100, A100 80 GB, L40S, RTX 4090 or L4 rate is published on the page read. Models named: RTX 4090, 5090, 3090, A100, H100, H200, L40S, A40, RTX A6000, 6000 Ada and RTX PRO 6000 in 1, 2, 4 or 8 card configurations; monthly rental of a whole machine is available.

per_object_cap.notes: the ceiling that matters is the machine shape

egress.terms: not published on the pages read

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
tooling: A web console with application templates (Stable Diffusion WebUI, ComfyUI, LoRA trainers, Text Generation WebUI), Jupyter terminal and SSH; data and shared model disks bill separately after an instance stops.
chaining: A Chinese-language GPU rental for image and video generation workloads; the only payment route stated is Alipay, which limits it to readers who hold an Alipay balance.

limits.value: the balance can only be funded through Alipay and every price is console-only

limits_note: Payment is Alipay only and prices are shown only inside the console after sign-in, so a rate cannot be read without an account.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: behind a sign-up. The page says to register or log in and top up the balance through Alipay, the only payment method stated, and names no email, phone or ID field; an Alipay balance normally ties the account to a mainland-China payment identity, which is not stated on the page read.

reliability_note: No reliability event was observed; the page warns that storage can keep billing after an instance stops and that data is unrecoverable after the instance or storage is deleted.
